title: The Geometry of Limits in ReLU Function Spaces
abstract: arXiv:2610.33779v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study the geometry and closure of spaces of functions realized by ReLU neural networks of fixed architecture. We first establish a general result about limits of continuous piecewise-linear (CPWL) functions: the minimum number of convex sets on which a function is affine is lower semicontinuous under pointwise convergence. The proof uses a connection to hypergraph coloring and a compactness principle, and yields quantitative bounds on the polyhedral complexity of continuous limits. We then characterize the functions realizable by shallow ReLU networks with vector-valued outputs, extending a known scalar-valued characterization. Using this and the geometry of limiting hyperplane arrangements, we prove that fixed-width shallow scalar ReLU realization spaces are closed in the weighted supremum norm on the whole input space. translated_title: ReLU函数空间中极限的几何学
translated_abstract: 我们研究了由固定架构的ReLU神经网络所实现的函数空间的几何性质与闭性。我们首先建立了关于连续分段线性（CPWL）函数极限的一个一般性结果：函数在其上为仿射的凸集的最小数量在逐点收敛下是下半连续的。该证明利用了与超图着色的联系以及一个紧性原理，并给出了连续极限的多面体复杂度的定量界。随后，我们刻画了具有向量值输出的浅层ReLU网络所能实现的函数，扩展了已知的标量值情形的刻画结果。利用这一点以及极限超平面排列的几何性质，我们证明了固定宽度的浅层标量ReLU实现空间在整个输入空间上的加权上确界范数下是闭的。与之相对，我们构造了一个架构为$(2,3,2\mid1)$的网络显式序列，其极限不可实……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文利用超图着色与下半连续性等工具证明了固定宽度浅层标量ReLU网络的实现空间在加权上确界范数下是闭的，同时构造了一个极限不可实现的显式反例网络序列。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that fixed-width shallow scalar ReLU realization spaces are closed in the weighted supremum norm, using lower semicontinuity of polyhedral complexity and hypergraph coloring, while also constructing an explicit counterexample network sequence whose limit is not realizable.
